result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual corporate history and navigation, with the mission statement as the only aspirational headline. Stakeholder framing is brief and third-person, with some first-person 'we' in the DEI and customer sections. Commitments are hedged ('believes', 'commitment') rather than absolute. Safety is absent; the page leans on milestones and product showcases.
